# Interfacer API

> Interfacer API is an integration platform for software teams. Instead of building and maintaining separate connections to hundreds of third-party services, developers call a single unified API. Interfacer handles OAuth and key management, automatic retries, rate-limit backoff, and webhook delivery, so product teams can ship integrations in days rather than quarters. The company was founded in 2021, is based in Minneapolis, MN, and maintains more than 300 connectors.

## Product

- [Home](https://interfacerapi.com/): One API for every API your product needs to talk to.
- [Product](https://interfacerapi.com/product.html): Unified API, Auth Vault, Relay Webhooks and Trace Console, and what each one does.
- [Customers](https://interfacerapi.com/customers.html): What Ledgerleaf, Fieldwise and Hirebridge Labs say about shipping integrations with Interfacer API.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://interfacerapi.com/pricing.html): Starter ($49), Team ($399) and custom Enterprise plans, with connected-account and API-call limits for each.

## Guides

- [Blog](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/index.html): Notes from the Interfacer API team on building and running integrations.
- [Why token refresh is the silent killer of integrations](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/why-token-refresh-is-the-silent-killer-of-integrat.html): Most broken integrations are caused by expired credentials nobody noticed, not API changes.
- [Retries done right: backoff, jitter, and knowing when to give up](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/retries-done-right-backoff-jitter-and-knowing-when.html): A practical guide to retrying third-party API calls without making an outage worse.
- [Build vs. buy: a checklist for your next integration](https://interfacerapi.com/blog/build-vs-buy-a-checklist-for-your-next-integration.html): Five questions to ask before your team commits a quarter to building a one-off connector.
